_comment: Dated, primary-sourced events behind Section 5.3 and Figure 3 of the arXiv preprint. Every row was checked against the URL in `source` on `accessed`. Hugging Face dates are the repository `createdAt` value returned by https://huggingface.co/api/models/<id>; X post dates are decoded from the status id (Snowflake epoch). Nothing here is from memory. Rows with `window: true` fall inside the two weeks Cesar asked about (2026-10-25 to 2026-11-08); the rest are the baseline the window builds on.

events.name: Wan2.2-T2V-A14B
events.note: Last Wan video model with published weights; Wan2.5, 2.7 and 3.0 are API-only on Alibaba Cloud Model Studio.

events.name: Z-Image
events.note: Z-Image-Turbo preceded it on 2025-11-25, also Apache-2.0.

events.name: MiniMax H3 (33B, video with native stereo audio)
events.license: MiniMax H3 Community License (release date 2026-08-02; excluded territories EU, UK, Republic of Korea, United States; separate authorization above USD 20M revenue; licensee must add an AI-generation identifier to outputs)
events.note: Announcement 2026-08-03; Hugging Face repository created 2026-07-28; 768 px short side locally, 2K through the hosted regeneration stage only; moderation is applied to the hosted service, not shipped in the weights.

events.name: Wan3.0 (up to 30 s native)
events.note: General availability on international channels; per-second pricing.

events.name: Qwen-Image-2.1 (7B generator, generation and editing)
events.note: Hugging Face repository created 2026-09-14; earlier Qwen-Image (2025-08) was Apache-2.0, so the licence tightened while the weights stayed public.

events.name: Sora API discontinued
events.note: Web and app experiences discontinued 2026-04-26.

events.name: Nano Banana 2.1 (gemini-nano-banana-2.1) GA
events.note: Outputs carry a SynthID watermark per the Gemini API image-generation documentation.

events.name: MOSS-Image-Base / MOSS-Image-SFT
events.note: Technical report arXiv:2610.23374.

events.name: FLUX 3 Image Klein (5.6B, native 4K, editing, 10 references)
events.note: INT8 build runs on 8 GB of VRAM; about 4 s per 1 MP image on an RTX 5090 (BFL figures, measured by NVIDIA); Hugging Face repository created 2026-10-13; base checkpoint for fine-tuning, LoRA training supported from day one.

events.name: Kling 4.0 fully available (30 s native, up to 15 references)
events.note: Company post, status 2110747537187709424.

events.name: Cosmos3-H-Dreams (action-conditioned surgical world model, image-to-video)
events.note: Built on Cosmos3-Nano; the Cosmos 3 family (text-to-image, world models) has shipped open weights since 2026-05-31 under OpenMDW 1.1.

events.name: Hy-Nomas (interactive video world model)
events.note: Technical report arXiv:2610.36729; company post 2026-10-23.

events.name: P-H3-Image (image model distilled from MiniMax H3, 8 steps, 8 MP)
events.note: A Chinese video model's weights repurposed as a European image generator in under three months.

events.name: Pika-H3-Flex (two LoRA adapters on MiniMax H3, 6-step video with audio)
events.license: MiniMax H3 Community License (inherited; its Applicable Territory excludes the United States)
events.note: A US company's open release that its own licence does not permit US users to run; 516 likes within ten days.

events.name: MiniMax-H3 prompt rewriters (Qwen3.5-9B, Qwen3.8-27B)
events.note: Ecosystem tooling that removes the hosted prompt-rewriting stage from the loop.

events.name: Qwen-Image-2.1-Lightning-v2-RL (full DiT, 4 steps, CFG 1.0)
events.note: Generation and editing in four denoising steps; a tenfold reduction from the 40-step original.

events.name: GPT-Image-2.6 Sunburst and Flare (API), ChatGPT Images 2.6
events.note: Changelog entry dated Nov 4; adds SVG and animated GIF generation and markup-guided editing.

events.name: Kling 4.0 Flash available to everyone, website and API
events.note: Company post, status 2117995299591319932.

events.name: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash GA (video up to 15 s per turn, 30 s total, 6 references)
events.note: Gemini API release notes, Nov 5, 2026.

events.name: p-h3-image-pdmd-2step (2-step distillation of P-H3-Image)
events.note: Third-generation derivative: H3 (video) to P-H3-Image (image) to a 2-step student, in eleven days.

regulation.instrument: Measures for Labeling AI-Generated Synthetic Content (国信办通字〔2025〕2号), four agencies, issued 2025-03-07, published 2025-03-14, in force 2025-09-01; companion mandatory standard GB 45438-2025
TAKE IT DOWN Act, Pub. L. 119-12; FTC enforcement of the platform removal duty from 2026-05-19
regulation.source: as cited in Bravo and Castanon Acuna (2026), SSRN 7222219, section 2.4

regulation.instrument: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (AI Act), art. 50 transparency obligations for providers and deployers of generative systems, applicable from 2026-08-02
